title: An old approach beneath later houses
position: Excavated area west of the Taharqa Gate.
question: How does a procession route become a residential area?
explanation: The 2016 field report describes Dynasty 25 paving under later fills and Ptolemaic construction. The changed ground levels show why a single plan cannot describe every moment of a temple precinct. A gate can cease to function as an entrance while the surrounding area acquires another use. This is a researched excavation context, not a promise that the exposed layers are currently visible to visitors.
lookFor: Compare phase plans, not just the present ground surface.

claims.text: The report distinguishes older paving, later landfill and Ptolemaic building west of the gate.

citations.locator: pp. 1–3, Excavation west of the Taharqa Gate

uncertainties: Exact demonstration photographs and safe on-site viewpoints must be checked before publication.
